scope: Read-only primary-source research; no training, stack install, model download, teacher inference or submission.

sources.title: Gemma 4 QAT models
claims: Google publishes unquantized QAT checkpoints as well as GGUF and compressed-tensors inference formats.
Transformers and Unsloth are named fine-tuning tools.
limits: General ecosystem support does not prove training directly on packed W4A16 CT or this competition's adapter compatibility.

sources.title: google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-w4a16-ct
claims: Model tree identifies unquantized QAT checkpoint as upstream.
Compressed-tensors format is for optimized vLLM inference.
Model card reports Apache-2.0.
limits: Live model card may differ from competition pinned snapshot.

sources.title: google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized
claims: An uncompressed half-precision QAT checkpoint exists, providing a better-aligned training-source candidate than ordinary IT.
limits: Selecting it as training source is this report's engineering inference, not an experimentally verified transfer result.

sources.title: Gemma4 CT config.json
claims: 4bit symmetric int weights, group_size32, compressed-tensors; no quantized activations specified.
60 text layers; hidden5376; MLP21504; local head_dim256; global head_dim512;32 query heads; local KV16/globalKV4; attention_k_eq_v=true;num_kv_shared_layers=0.
limits: Configuration size estimates exclude activations, optimizer and runtime allocations.

sources.title: Google Gemma4 model variations
claims: 官方元数据列出普通 IT、QAT 未压缩、CT 的版本及文件总量。
limits: 未下载权重；文件总量不是训练显存。

sources.title: Gemma4 Fine-tuning Guide
claims: Maintainer claims31B QLoRA works with22GB VRAM.
Guide links maintainer31B Kaggle notebook and describes training/template issues.
limits: Memory claim depends on maintainer workload; not verified here.
Do not assume third-party bugs for E2B/E4B apply to31B.

sources.title: Gemma4-31B-Unsloth
claims: 读取作者 v3 notebook 的普通 IT 四位加载、8192 上下文和 rank 8 示例。
limits: 代码单元输出为空，不能验证完成运行、资源用量或 CT 迁移。

sources.title: PEFT quantization guide
claims: NF4/doublequant/BF16 compute and prepare_model_for_kbit_training are documented.
LoftQ fits quantization error and its on-the-fly helper currently supports bitsandbytes4bit.
limits: NF4 is not the competition CT quantization; no equivalence claim.

sources.title: vLLM Gemma4 model implementation
claims: Text projections are packed by layer;K=V full attention mapsK intoK/V shards.
MLP gate/up use packed projection mapping.
limits: Main-branch code is not proof of identical competition installed code.
Adapter target/key compatibility still needs exporter/runtime evidence.

sources.title: Training Software Engineering Agents and Verifiers with SWE-Gym
claims: 作者报告专家轨迹 SFT 增益，也报告特定自产成功数据混合后的退化。
limits: 不同模型、scaffold 和时间预算；不意味着所有自训练无效。

sources.title: OpenHands-SFT-Trajectories
claims: 作者数据卡列出 491 条成功轨迹和 MIT 许可。
limits: 未下载完整语料；工具映射和来源尚需逐例核查。

sources.title: SWE-smith: Scaling Data for Software Engineering Agents
claims: 作者报告 5016 条轨迹的单次修复结果及每题最多三条的限制。
limits: 论文分数不能转换为比赛预期收益。

sources.title: SWE-smith trajectories
claims: 作者数据卡标 MIT，具有多个序列化 split 和 resolved 标签。
limits: 当前数据总量不是原论文训练规模；原训练条数与论文存在一条差异。

sources.title: SWE-smith toolkit
claims: MIT toolkit;Linux/Docker environment construction;trajectory/task resources.
limits: Does not support claiming macOS can directly reproduce full environment pipeline.

sources.title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
claims: 研究加权交互 SFT 和有区分力的验证奖励。
limits: 整体任务曾用于失败分析；模型及长预算不同；未找到明确作者训练代码链接。

sources.title: FC-SWE: Failure-Conditioned RL for Long-Horizon Software Engineering Agents
claims: 研究失败条件恢复，并为每次实际执行保留独立奖励。
limits: 测试重试获得 benchmark 反馈，部分测试题参与选 checkpoint，不是五分钟 Gemma 实验。

sources.title: Building Coding Agents via Entropy-Enhanced Multi-Turn Preference Optimization
claims: SFT 后进行熵增强多轮偏好训练；作者公开实现与模型。
limits: 论文使用较大多卡、长上下文及多候选推理，超参仅为参考。

sources.title: rLLM DeepSWE example
claims: 提供公开 RL 环境、训练和评测入口。
limits: 旧框架已迁移组织；不是现成 Gemma 配方。

sources.title: gemma-tpu
claims: 公开 Cloud TPU 的 Gemma 4 LoRA 与格式转换实现存在。
limits: 不能据此推断 Kaggle TPU 具备相同运行栈。

sources.title: LoRA loading and self-generated training data
claims: 主办方允许 Gemma 自产训练数据，并曾说明修正 LoRA 加载。
limits: 历史回复不是本项目 adapter 的评分成功证据。

sources.title: Clarification on distillation from external LLMs
claims: 主办方允许符合模型及比赛许可要求的外部模型使用。
limits: 不是任意教师供应商条款的无条件授权。

sources.title: Allowed training data for LoRA adapters
claims: 主办方明确允许其他开放权重模型轨迹与既有公开非 Gemma SWE 轨迹。
limits: 不代表任意数据集已通过质量或协议验证。

sources.title: Can we send released task data to DeepSeek API
claims: 本次返回中未见 released task 数据外发 API 的明确主办方回复。
limits: 未答复不等于已禁止。

sources.title: Stronger models barely beat Gemma4 in this harness
claims: 参赛者报告同旧 harness 下的教师对照和 Gemma 重复运行波动。
limits: 教师单次、预算较长且环境有本地修改，不是本项目五分钟配对实验。

sources.title: Are you seeing gains with distillation
claims: 作者表示特定教师在相同约束下收益有限。
limits: 只是经历报告，不用于预测训练收益。

sources.title: Has anyone confirmed LoRA in scored run
claims: 参赛者报告双 T4 训练失败及极小零 adapter 评分失败。

claims: 作者宣传 50 条 Gemma 轨迹，描述与元数据许可字段不一致。
limits: 未下载内容，质量、来源及许可一致性未验证。

sources.title: gemma4-tfd-agent
